dataFlow.reason: Presentational overlay fed by a `notifications` prop; no route data.

guards: focus moves run inside event handlers only, never during SSR

gaps: ARC ships this as a `block` (kind: block) and imports its own `Avatar`; the port therefore depends on `$lib/components/avatar/avatar.svelte`, which was ported alongside it.

Phase 1 still-port: the motion helpers are static — `SwapText`/`Swap` render plain spans, `RollingCount` renders the value, `MorphWidth` is a plain span, and the AnimatePresence-driven badge/view-highlight/list/footer appear/disappear without animation. The view highlight's `layoutId` slide, the row cascade (`--index` stagger), the odometer roll and the panel enter/exit are Phase 2.
The `bulk` state (which only modulated the exit cascade) is omitted in Phase 1; it returns with the motion wiring.
ARC's `.panel` reads `var(--radix-popover-content-transform-origin)`; bits-ui sets `var(--bits-popover-content-transform-origin)` (same as the popover port). Inert in Phase 1; alias in Phase 2.
